messages:
harry: Hey infra team — onboarding a new enterprise account in eu-south-1. They need a dedicated GPU pool (A100) + predictable egress for model pulls and telemetry. Opening this thread to align on VPC/subnet layout, NAT scaling, and quota asks. TL;DR: large ENI/IP need, NAT bandwidth, PrivateLink to marketplace images, and GPU quota bump.

ashwin: Can you paste the rough numbers we need? GPUs, pods, expected outbound throughput, and whether we need static egress IPs? :eyes:

harry: Rough sketch: 8 dedicated A100 instances to start, scale to 40 in 3 months. Each instance may host multiple agents and needs ~50 secondary IPs for pods/ENIs. So target: 40 instances * 50 IPs = 2000 secondary private IPs. Also need 4 static NAT EIPs for HA, but likely need >4 for SNAT port exhaustion. Expected egress: avg 6 Gbps, spikes to 18 Gbps during model pulls pre-warm.

maria: For AWS: secondary IPs are bounded by ENI and instance type limits. A100 instance type (p4d / p5d) has fewer ENI attachments but more IPs per ENI — we should confirm exact limits per AZ. Suggest opening a support ticket for 'VPC IP address quota' and 'EC2 network interfaces' quotas.

len: Alternative: use AWS NAT Gateway + Gateway Load Balancer for scaling and preserve ports using EIP pooling + NAT Gateway per AZ. But NAT GW port limits can hit SNAT exhaustion; we should design for ~64k ephemeral ports per EIP (minus OS). If we need 2000 concurrent connections per pod, 4 EIPs may be insufficient. I'd model expected concurrent connections and reserve extra EIPs or use NAT instances with port proxying if necessary.

harry: Good point. I ran a quick calc: if each pod needs ~50 concurrent ports, 2k pods => 100k concurrent ports. Each EIP ~64k, but AWS NAT's per-flow behavior reduces usable. So plan for 3 NAT GW per AZ with 3 EIPs each (9 total) to be safe. Cost estimate for NAT GW + EIPs (rough): $0.045/hr per NAT GW + $0.005/hr per EIP + data egress $0.09/GB => ~ $5k/month for steady 6 Gbps egress. Need to confirm with finance.

infra-bot: auto-ticket: Created support ticket #INC-2026-834 for EC2 ENI/secondary IP quota increase request. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#INC-2026-834

ashwin: Thanks infra-bot. For PrivateLink/Privatelink-equivalent: they want access to marketplace AMIs and a few vendor registries without public egress. For GCP/Azure we can use Private Service Connect/Private Link endpoints. For AWS we can request interface endpoints for S3 (if using VPC gateway endpoints), ECR, and the marketplace. Marketplace via PrivateLink is sometimes vendor-specific. Do we need to route image pulls through S3/ECR endpoints or via a dedicated bastion?

clara: If marketplace images require a public endpoint, one option is to mirror images into our central account (shared services) and serve via ECR repo replication + cross-account roles. That eliminates the need for marketplace privatelink in the customer's VPC. Adds storage and replication cost but simplifies egress audit.

maria: For subnet CIDR planning, propose /16 hub VPC and /22 per AZ for worker subnets to give ~1024 addresses per subnet. Example plan:
```
hub VPC: 10.100.0.0/16
worker eu-south-1a: 10.101.0.0/22
worker eu-south-1b: 10.101.4.0/22
worker eu-south-1c: 10.101.8.0/22
shared-services: 10.102.0.0/24
management/bastion: 10.102.1.0/24
```
This gets us enough IP headroom for ENIs + future scaling. We'll also reserve some /28s for interface endpoints.

len: Also request raising VPC elastic IP quota for the account. Default is 5 EIPs, we need 9+ as discussed. Please include expected monthly EIP count and justification in the support ticket.

harry: I'll update INC-2026-834 with details and attach the subnet plan and link to cost calc. Also starting a GPU quota ticket for EC2-A100 family: request from 8 -> 40 in eu-south-1 initial, with gradual increase to 80 if successful.

clara: Can you include the expected commit/term in ticket? For Dedicated we'd prefer reserved capacity but ticket needs numbers: monthly vCPU/GPU hours, expected start date, and whether we need AZ affinity.

harry: Start date target: 2026-05-15. Committed baseline: 40 A100-hours/day => ~1200 GPU-hours/month initially. AZ affinity: prefer multi-AZ spread, no strict affinity.

sre-oncall: For observability and health, we should wire up per-subnet flow logs and a NAT gateway metric dashboard (BytesOut, ActiveFlows, Error counts). Also recommend enabling AWS Network Firewall or security groups for vendor traffic. If port exhaustion happens we can autoscale additional NAT GW and announce via Route53 failover policy.

ashwin: Action items: 1) harry updates support tickets (ENI/IP, EIP, EC2 quota) with numbers and subnet plan. 2) infra to validate instance ENI/IP capabilities per AZ (len/maria). 3) decide on image mirroring plan (clara). 4) finance to review estimated NAT costs (tag me).

harry: Will do. Adding support ticket notes now and pinging finance. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: One more note — if customer needs regulatory controls (no public egress), we should recommend Private deployment option or VPC endpoint-only config. Will add compliance checklist to the ticket.

harry: Good call. I'll mark compliance required. Closing the loop here, will post updates in this thread when tickets progress.
